decisions.reason: The ID Vault builds directly on KOBIL's core digital identity and secure storage expertise, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and fold it into the super-app platform, though as a single feature it could be merged or renamed.

An identity-bound wallet uses the firm's identity and payment capabilities, but it overlaps heavily with the payment and wallet framework and was only mentioned in passing, so consolidation is a real risk.

NFC tag login extends KOBIL's long-standing authentication and hardware-security knowledge, but it is a niche item with thin market visibility that may be absorbed into the broader authenticator offering.
The secure payment and wallet framework has its own page and combines the firm's integrated payment and security capabilities, which makes it a core building block of the super-app strategy.
The multi-service mobile app platform is the essence of the firm's strategic direction and draws on its full knowledge base, so dropping it is very unlikely.

Application shielding rests on decades of application-security expertise and patented technology, has its own page, and serves as a standalone and embedded component that the firm can readily improve.
